# Configuration Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-config-doc.py from tools/ConfigDump output. Do not hand-edit defaults. -->

Defaults below are produced from `src/Config.cs` (after `Validate()`). The shipped `DEFAULT-*.json` files and `CONFIG-REFERENCE.md` are generated from the same output by `scripts/refresh-config-files.sh`; CI fails if they drift.

## Files and lifecycle

* `VintagestoryData/ModConfig/thelastwatchzombiesconfigmain.json` — gameplay settings (`main`).
* `VintagestoryData/ModConfig/thelastwatchzombiesconfigadvanced.json` — budgets, tuning, markers (`advanced`).
* Load order: built-in defaults ← advanced ← main, then `Config.Validate()` clamps every value into its allowed range (out-of-range values are silently corrected).
* **The server rewrites both files on every start** with every non-retired key, so values persist but unknown or retired keys are removed. Back up custom files before upgrading.
* `/zombieconfig <key> [value]` edits the saved file (validated, case-insensitive keys) — **restart required**. The 51 short command names are listed in `COMMANDS.md`.
* Pre-merge files (`seventhnightconfig*.json`, `thelastwatchconfig*.json`) are not read.
* Clients read their own local copy only for funeral-mask durability display.

Status column: **A** active · **I** inert in v2.0.9 (written, never read) · **M** one-time migration marker (no gameplay effect).

### Regenerating

```bash
bash scripts/fetch-vs-server.sh 1.22.7 vs-server
bash scripts/refresh-config-files.sh vs-server
```

## Fixed constants (not configurable)

| Constant | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Zone size | 3×3 chunks (96×96 blocks) | `WatchZone.ChunksPerSide` |
| Stronghold reinforcement (wood / copper / iron) | 5 / 50 / 300 | `LastWatchZones` |
| Permanent settlement | ≥25 stone paths + ≥1 stronghold | `LastWatchZones.Placed` |
| Bonfire: protect / lure rings | ≥3 stacks / 6, 9, 12 stacks → 1, 2, 3 rings | `LastWatchZones.BonfireRadius` |
| Bonfire burn time | 9 in-game hours | `BlockEntityPitBonfire.BurnHours` |
| Rot bait lure radius / bite interval | 32 blocks / 2 s per pile | `RotBaitRules` |
| Stake trap radius / hold / damage / lifetime | 2 blocks / 3–20 s / 5 / 30 s | `PalisadeTrapRules`, `StakeTimer` |
| Screamer summons | 10 normals, retried for 60 s | `ZombieVariants.cs` |
| Variant HP (Grabber/Hive/Screamer/Bloater) | entity JSON | `assets/seventhnightzombies/entities/*.json` |
| Cure dose heal | 20 HP | `TryTakeCureDose` |
| Zombieween seed | 5 normals per zone + 2 cures per online player | `LastWatchZones` |
| Psychedelic strengths | 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.4, 2.0 | `MushroomPsychedelicStrengths` |
